cards.title: Override vs. resubmission are different outcomes (decision 93; fixes audit 2.11)
items: A false negative (scanned/renamed file the automated check misreads) is overridden by Lead/Approver with a required reason, logged as a distinct event type from the automated status — the audit trail always shows machine-check vs. human-override provenance
A confirmed true positive never gets overridden — it routes to "request resubmission" instead, reverting intake_status to pending so all_submitted can't fire until the LFI actually resubmits

cards.title: Diagram scope
items: Covers the call sequence behind lfi-intake-tab-v1.html's lane/phase view; document open/download via the Ingestion Adapter (decision 94, no custom viewer) isn't a call worth its own message here

The Ingestion Adapter's own poll/fetch/SFTP cycle is drawn in lfi-pipeline-v1.html, not repeated here. Every write here routes through log_checkpoint() (tool-contracts.md), same single write path as every other checkpoint

The adapter's retry/terminal-failure split is drawn in full here (not just referenced) since this is the SFTP-facing boundary with the system's largest external-content surface — the other new sequence diagrams defer to tool-contracts.md by reference instead, since their calls are UI-gated human actions without a comparable retry policy of their own
